description.value: The Museum of Natural History is operated by Vancouver Island University on its main Nanaimo campus, housing collections related to natural science disciplines taught at the university. As a university teaching museum, it serves both students and the broader public with exhibits in areas such as geology, botany, and natural history. Touring cyclists exploring Nanaimo can visit the campus setting, which sits within the broader VIU grounds.
